chequeState.received: Cheque received — not a receipt of payment
chequeState.exception_pending: Partial match, waiting for a second person

wording.instructionBody: An approval only allows the movement. Nothing has moved until each side is settled on evidence: a matched statement line for a bank side, a witnessed slip for a cash side.
wording.cheque: Cheque received — not a receipt of payment
wording.chequeBody: A cheque settles nothing until its bank line clears it. Only then is a payment allocated and a receipt issued.
wording.sampleBody: Demo document, fictional data. Generated by the prototype's demo helper for an account's pending items. It is imported and matched like any statement; it never settles anything by itself.

evidence.counter: Cash at the office counter, received by {{name}}

accounts.intro: The society's bank accounts (the verified collection accounts themselves) and its cash. Every balance is the cashbook's: settled money only.
accounts.howAdded: A bank account is added or changed only through the verified-account workflow in the site's collection settings (proposed by one person, approved by another, then a cooling-off period). Cash and petty cash are accounts of the same association.

cashbook.intro: Every settled movement of cash and bank, with its evidence and its record. Nothing is typed in here: the lines come from payments, posted vouchers and settled transfers.
cashbook.emptyBody: Nothing was settled in this month for this selection. Pending items are listed below.
cashbook.pendingIntro: Never in a balance until settled on evidence. Cash in transit now: {{amount}}.
cashbook.reconciliationIntro: The cashbook's bank movements against the imported statement lines of each verified account. Unmatched lines explain any difference.

dashboard.title: Society finance
dashboard.intro: {{site}} · {{entity}}. Balances come only from settled money; everything still on its way is shown apart.
dashboard.waiting: Still on its way (not in any balance)
dashboard.waitingIntro: Owed, pending, in transit or waiting for evidence. Each opens its records.
dashboard.closed: {{period}} is closed: postings dated in it are refused.
dashboard.approvalsNone_other: Nothing waits for you. {{count}} requests wait for others.
dashboard.derived: Every figure is derived from settled source events (payments, posted vouchers, settled transfer legs). There is no separate cashbook to keep in step.
dashboard.approvalsNone_one: Nothing waits for you. {{count}} request waits for someone else.

ladder.title: Billed, collected, received, settled: {{period}}
ladder.intro: Four different numbers. A bill is not money; a receipt can be cash still in the office; only a matched statement line shows money in the bank.
ladder.billedWhy_other: {{count}} invoices issued for this month (what residents owe)
ladder.collectedWhy_other: {{count}} payments with a receipt, any method
ladder.cashReceivedWhy_other: {{count}} cash payments, counted at the office (may not be banked yet)
ladder.billedWhy_one: {{count}} invoice issued for this month (what residents owe)
ladder.collectedWhy_one: {{count}} payment with a receipt, any method
ladder.cashReceivedWhy_one: {{count}} cash payment, counted at the office (may not be banked yet)
ladder.bankSettledWhy_one: {{count}} credit matched to a statement line

kpi.cashAwaitingCount: Office cash waiting for a count

describe.in_transit: {{from}} → {{to}}: left one account, not yet in the other
describe.cash_awaiting_count: Cash recorded by {{name}} for {{payers}}, waiting for a second count

voucher.subtitle: Cash that no other module records: other income and small expenses. Approved by someone else, then posted; never edited after posting.
voucher.title: Cash voucher {{ref}}
voucher.periodClosedBody: Postings dated in a closed month are refused. Ask for the month to be reopened (an approval), or date the correction in an open month.
voucher.reversalBody: The original stays as posted. This voucher cancels it with the opposite movement, approved like any voucher.
voucher.dateHint: As YYYY-MM-DD. It decides the month; a closed month refuses it.
voucher.reverseEffect: A reversal voucher with the opposite movement is prepared for today and sent for approval. The original stays as posted.
voucher.reversalPrepared: Reversal prepared and sent for approval
voucher.rulesBody: The approval policy in force decides: up to its limit the treasurer approves; above it, two committee officers. You can never approve your own voucher.
voucher.noEvidence: No document attached yet. A voucher needs one.

count.title: Count cash
count.subtitle: Count the notes; a second person witnesses the count. The cashbook's figure is shown beside it.
count.needsWitness: Someone else must witness this count before it counts for closing the month.

close.title: Close {{period}}
close.isClosedBody: Postings dated in it are refused. Reopening needs an approval by someone other than the person asking.
close.readyBody: Every blocking check passes. Warnings are recorded with the close.
close.blockedBody: Each opens the records to resolve. Nothing is closed until all pass.

check.proofs_waiting: No proof waiting for its bank line or a decision
check.open_exceptions: No partial match waiting for a second person
check.vouchers_open: No voucher waiting for approval or posting
check.unsettled_instructions: No instruction waiting for approval or settlement
check.batches_open: No office collection waiting for confirmation
check.cash_counted: Cash counted and witnessed, agreeing with the books

close.notCounted: No witnessed count on or after the month's last day
close.awaitingWitness: {{account}}: {{amount}} counted by {{name}}, waiting for a witness
close.reopenBody: Only through an approval under the policy in force, decided by someone other than you.

events.posting_refused: was refused a posting dated in it

close.confirmEffect: Postings dated in {{period}} will be refused until an approved reopening.

account.bankIntro: A verified bank account of the association. Its movements come from matched statement lines.
account.cashIntro: Cash kept by {{name}}. Its movements come from witnessed counts, office payments, vouchers and slips.
account.title: Account title
account.beneficiaryNote: This is the verified account record of the collection settings, not a copy: its details change only there, with a second person's approval.
account.linesIntro_other: Lines of the statements imported for this account ({{count}} statements). Identity: account, source and the bank's own id.
account.noLines: No statement imported for this account yet
account.linesIntro_one: Lines of the statements imported for this account ({{count}} statement). Identity: account, source and the bank's own id.

transfer.intro: Cash taken to the bank, money moved between the society's own accounts, cash drawn for petty cash. Each is an instruction first; only evidence settles it.
transfer.newSubtitle: Between this association's own accounts only. Approved under the policy by someone other than you.
transfer.inTransitNow: Cash in transit now: {{amount}} (left the office, not yet on a statement line).
transfer.emptyBody: Prepare one to bank the office cash or move money between accounts.
transfer.referenceHint: What the bank will print (the deposit slip or transfer reference). Left empty, the instruction's own reference is used.
transfer.title: Instruction {{ref}}

legState.slip_recorded: Slip recorded, waiting for a witness
legState.exception_pending: Partial match, waiting for a second person

transfer.needsLine: Settles only on a statement line of this account that matches in full (amount, date, reference, name); a partial match needs a second person's exception.
transfer.needsSlip: Settles only on a slip recorded by one person and witnessed by another.
transfer.settledLine: Settled on statement line {{txn}} ({{date}}), matched by {{by}}.
transfer.settledException: Settled on statement line {{txn}} ({{date}}) through an exception approved by {{approver}}.
transfer.settledSlip: Settled on slip {{slip}} ({{date}}): recorded by {{by}}, witnessed by {{witness}}.
transfer.slipRecorded: Slip {{slip}} recorded by {{name}}; waiting for someone else to witness it.
transfer.witnessed: Slip witnessed: this side is settled
transfer.exceptionApproved: Exception approved: this side is settled
transfer.exceptionRejected: Exception rejected: the line is released
transfer.noCandidates: No line could prove this side yet.
transfer.exceptionReason: Why this partly matching line is the right one
transfer.requestException: Ask a second person to approve
transfer.exceptionRequested: Exception sent to a second person
transfer.notYours: You prepared this instruction, so someone else matches its bank lines.
transfer.full: Full match: amount, date, reference and name
transfer.cancelEffect: Nothing has been settled, so nothing moves. The instruction is kept, marked cancelled.

demo.title: Sample statement (demo helper)
demo.subtitle: Writes what the bank would show for this account's pending items. It settles nothing: import it, then match each line.
demo.imported_other: {{count}} lines imported; match them to settle
demo.importBy: Importing a statement is for the accounts officer (bank reconciliation).
demo.nothingBody: No deposited cheque, approved transfer or cleared cheque needs a statement line here.
demo.imported_one: {{count}} line imported; match it to settle

batch.intro: Collect dues at the office for many flats at once. Cash is counted twice (you, then a second person); cheques are only acknowledged until their bank line clears them.
batch.cashRule: You count the cash and submit; someone else counts it again and confirms. Only then are payments and receipts created, each settling that payer's own lines.
batch.emptyBody: Start one when residents bring cash or cheques to the office.
batch.title: Office collection {{ref}}
batch.confirmed: Confirmed: receipts issued for cash, cheques acknowledged
batch.notYours: A second person confirms it. You can see it, but you cannot confirm your own collection.
batch.noLines: Find a flat or payer above to add lines.
batch.submitBody: Count the cash in hand. It must equal the cash lines ({{amount}}).
batch.submitted: Submitted: waiting for a second person
batch.reviewBody: {{name}} counted {{amount}} in cash. Count it yourself; it must agree. Cheques ({{count}}) are only acknowledged.
batch.returnEffect: Nothing is recorded. The collector corrects it and submits again.
batch.chequePending: a cheque is waiting to clear

problem.payer_not_liable: This person is not liable on {{account}}.
problem.cash_not_allowed: Office cash is not turned on for this site.
problem.cheque_not_allowed: Cheques are not turned on for this site.
problem.cheque_details: Give the drawer's bank, a 6–10 digit number and the date.
problem.cheque_post_dated: Dated later than the site allows (post-dated).
problem.cheque_duplicate_in_batch: The same cheque is on another line.

warning.more_than_owed: More than owed now (Rs {{open}}); the rest stays as credit.
warning.proof_pending: a transfer proof is already waiting for this payer
warning.same_payer_twice: The same payer appears twice with the same method.

batch.singleOrigin: A single office payment recorded at the counter

cheque.pendingTotal: Waiting to clear (not in any balance): {{amount}}
cheque.emptyBody: Cheques taken at the office appear once their collection is confirmed.
cheque.title: Cheque {{ref}}
cheque.depositedToast: Deposit recorded: waiting for the bank line
cheque.linesTitle: Clear it on its bank line
cheque.linesBody: A credit line of the deposit account with this amount and cheque number. A partial match needs a second person.
cheque.cleared: Cleared: payment allocated and receipt issued
cheque.reversalTitle: If the bank took it back
cheque.reversalBody: Choose the bank's debit for this cheque. The reversal is approved by a second person; then the payment, its allocation and the receipt are reversed (never deleted) and the lines reopen.
cheque.clearedNote: Cleared on its statement line: the payment and receipt exist only from this point.
cheque.returnEffect: Nothing was settled, so nothing is undone. The payer is told (in-app, simulated).
cheque.memoHint: As printed on the bank's return memo, if any.
cheque.reversedBody: {{reason}}. The payment, its allocation and the receipt were reversed; the lines are open again.
cheque.handedBack: Handed back to the payer before depositing

events.cleared: cleared it on its bank line

office.witnessTitle: Cash here is counted by two people
office.witnessBody: This site records every office cash payment through an office collection: you count it, a second person counts it again and confirms.
office.countRuleTitle: Counted by a second person before any receipt
office.countRuleBody: You record the cash; a second person at the office counts it and confirms. Only then is the payment settled and a receipt issued. Until then the bill is not paid.
office.awaitingTitle: Cash recorded: waiting for a second count
office.awaitingBody: {{amount}} for {{account}} ({{payer}}) is in office collection {{ref}}. No receipt yet: the bill stays unpaid until the cash is counted and confirmed.
office.wouldSettle: If confirmed now, it would settle
office.replayed: This cash was already recorded (the same request again): nothing was added.

credits.paidInAdvance: Paid in advance: settles the next bills, oldest first

settings.witnessSingle: Receipt at once (counted by one person)
settings.witnessSecond: Counted by two people (through an office collection)
settings.witnessHint: Bulk office collections always need a second person. Whether single payments do too is the owner's decision (D-46); the demo keeps C.2's receipt at once.
settings.chequeRules: Payable to {{payee}}; post-dated up to {{days}} days.
settings.feesHint: Charged once per society transfer, at the rate in force, with the bylaw that allows it. A new rate is a new version from a future date.
settings.witnessFixed: Every office cash payment, single or in a collection, is counted and confirmed by a second person before its receipt (owner decision D-46). The cash limit is still the society’s own setting.

problems.amount: Enter an amount above zero (up to two decimals).
problems.required: At least {{min}} characters are needed here.
problems.periodClosed: {{period}} is closed: nothing dated in it can be posted. Ask for it to be reopened, or date the correction in an open month.
problems.account_unknown: Not an account of this association.
problems.balance_not_zero: Dues are still outstanding on this flat.
problems.bank_evidence_required: Choose the statement line that proves it.
problems.blocking_checks: Some checks still block the close.
problems.cash_leg_first: Settle the cash side first: the bank cannot show cash that has not left the office.
problems.category_direction: This category does not fit money in that direction.
problems.count_mismatch: The cash counted does not equal the cash lines ({{lines}}).
problems.cross_entity_forbidden: Money never moves to another association or the platform.
problems.decide_own_request: You asked for this; someone else decides.
problems.decide_conflict_of_interest: You are named in this request; someone else decides.
problems.decide_not_an_approver: The policy in force does not name you for this.
problems.decide_permission_missing: Your role does not decide approvals.
problems.decide_delegate_own_request: A delegate never acts for the person who asked.
problems.delegate_to: End on or after the start, at most 90 days later.
problems.delegate_unknown: Choose a colleague who decides approvals.
problems.effective_date: Give the first day of a month not yet billed ({{period}} or later).
problems.exception_required: This line matches only in part ({{missing}} differ): ask a second person for an exception.
problems.expense_owned_by_payables: With payables in your plan, expenses are recorded there, not as cash vouchers.
problems.fee_from: A new rate starts on a future date.
problems.flat_unknown: Not a flat of this site.
problems.full_match_use_match: This line matches in full: settle on it directly.
problems.insufficient_cash: The cash account would go below zero.
problems.insufficient_funds: More than the account can send now (available {{available}}).
problems.invalid_state: Not possible in its current state.
problems.line_taken: That line already proves something else, or is held for it.
problems.maker_checker_required: Someone other than you must do this.
problems.meeting_date: Give a date on or before today.
problems.member_already_holds: This owner already holds an office for these dates.
problems.member_unknown: Choose an owner in the register.
problems.no_fee_rate: No transfer fee rate is in force.
problems.no_owner: This flat has no owner on record.
problems.no_policy_rule: No approval rule covers this: the policy must name who approves it.
problems.no_reminder_policy: No reminder rules are in force.
problems.not_collector: Only the person who collected it can change it.
problems.not_delegator: Only the person who delegated can end it.
problems.not_preparer: Only the person who prepared it can change it.
problems.office_taken: This office already has a holder for those dates.
problems.payer_not_liable: This person is not liable on {{account}}.
problems.permission_missing: Your role does not allow this.
problems.phone_fictional: Use a fictional number: +92 399 nnn nnnn.
problems.policy_approvers: Name at least one office or role.
problems.policy_band: The upper amount must be above the lower one.
problems.policy_draft_exists: A draft or pending version already exists.
problems.policy_effective: A new version starts on a future date.
problems.reminder_cap: Between one and six a month.
problems.reminder_in_app: Every step includes the in-app reminder.
problems.reminder_steps: Give up to six steps, each on a different day.
problems.reversal_line_mismatch: That debit is not this cheque (its amount and number must match).
problems.reversal_not_supported: Only office cash payments are reversed here; cheques use the bank's debit; transfers are refunds (a later gate).
problems.reversal_pending: A reversal already waits for approval.
problems.run_not_posted: Only a posted run has bills to print.
problems.same_owner: The new owner must be someone else.
problems.slip_date: Date the slip on or after the instruction, not in the future.
problems.transfer_accounts: These accounts do not fit this kind of movement.
problems.transfer_open: This flat already has a transfer in progress.
problems.votes_outcome: An approved resolution needs more votes for than against.
problems.voucher_cash_only: Cash vouchers are for cash accounts; bank movements are proved by statement lines.
problems.voucher_date: Date it on or before today, in September 2026 or later.
problems.witness_not_recorder: The witness must be someone other than the person who recorded it.
problems.witness_policy: Choose one of the two options.
problems.cheque_details: Give the drawer's bank, a 6–10 digit number and the date.
problems.cheque_not_allowed: Cheques are not turned on for this site.
problems.cheque_post_dated: Dated later than the site allows.
problems.allocationAtCount: Office cash is allocated when a second person has counted it (oldest bills first); an allocation cannot be chosen at the counter.
problems.witness_required: Every office cash payment is counted by a second person (owner decision D-46); a single counter cannot be chosen.

cashAwaiting.title: {{amount}} in office cash waiting for a second count
cashAwaiting.body: Recorded by {{name}} on {{date}} in {{ref}}. It is not a payment yet: no receipt, and the bill stays unpaid until it is counted and confirmed.
